data.heading: Joining Maplewood Academy
data.subheading: Guidance for parents applying for the coming school year.

items.question: When do applications open?
items.answer: Applications open on 1 September and close on 15 January for entry the following autumn.

items.question: Do you offer open days?
items.answer: Yes. We hold open mornings each month, and private tours can be booked any weekday.

items.question: What is the class size?
items.answer: We cap classes at 22 pupils, with a teaching assistant in every year group up to Year 4.

items.question: Are scholarships available?
items.answer: Means-tested bursaries and academic and music scholarships are available from Year 7.

items.question: Is there wraparound care?
items.answer: Breakfast club runs from 7:30am and after-school clubs finish at 6pm.
